title: 第3271章 商议计划第3270章 被困住的人
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
夺舍……顶替身份……
这两个词一出，秦伏天立刻想起来前世，挚友天罗神帝与他的妻子凤瑶光被魔族的魔帝夺舍，联手杀死他。
导致秦伏天误会了凤瑶光与挚友多年，差点彻底斩断与凤瑶光的情缘。
秦伏天两世为人，后怕过的事情不多，可每每想起当初的事情，秦伏天都非常后悔。
如果当初他谨慎一些，做好对魔界的防备，好友就不会死去，妻子凤瑶光也不会失去记忆。
这种悔恨的情绪，不至于让秦伏天生出心魔，却会让秦伏天遇到相关事情时，格外关注。
“依靠夺舍来抢夺他人的身份，这种人……该死！”
秦伏天眼眸微冷，却摇了摇头。
“不行，我无法带其他人离开。”
有法则之力的加持，秦伏天能够让自己随意穿梭金属与土地，但想要带其他人穿梭消耗会非常大，是他现在还负担不起的。
要不是秦伏天今天晚上吸收了那名鬼修体内已经炼化的能量，突破到了练气三层，他自己都无法进入这里。
即便拥有法则之力，没有足够的力量操控，也只能自保而已。
风梧桐闻言，稍微有些失望，但还是洒脱地摆了摆小胖手。
“没事，只要你能将消息传递出去，我已经感激不尽了。将来如果你有机会见到凤家的人，记得帮我说一声，我风梧桐不是孬种，最好让他们帮我灭了龙婆谷。”
之前搭话的女人则有些失望，但同样恳切地说：“还望道友能去清盛市，帮我给纳家的人带句话。
我叫南塔娜，我姐姐名叫帕琳，你只需要让他们去我母亲的暗格中看看，自然能够证明你的身份。”
担心秦伏天拒绝，南塔娜忙道：“我纳家乃是东南亚一带有名的翡翠大亨，掌握众多修炼资源，事后必当重谢。”
南塔娜，帕琳，纳家……
秦伏天心中默念着这三个名字，感觉有些拗口。
他再次摇了摇头，淡淡地说：“不必这么悲观，明天我想办法解决这里的麻烦，从外面打开这扇房门，届时你们自然能够离开。”

这个房间并不是完全封闭的，在秦伏天进来的墙壁对面，有一面比墙壁更厚实的金属大门，而且大门内侧刻有魔纹，外侧刻有鬼阵以检查来者的身份，防御效果极佳。
他虽然能够打开，却无法做到不惊扰其他人。
“按照龙婆谷的规矩，平时只有一名鬼修驻守此地，保护龙婆的安全。但距离此处不到千米，还有一个小村，里面居住的全是练气期的鬼修，甚至有练气巅峰的鬼修坐镇。
只要惊动了他们，我倒是不怕，但你们绝对会被疯狂追杀，以你们现在的状态，恐怕讨不到好。”
才刚刚突破到练气三层的秦伏天淡然说道。
之前帮凤梧桐破解符文锁链的时候，并没有掩饰自己的修为。
其他人修为低，意识恍惚认不出来，但凤梧桐和南塔娜两人能轻易地感受到秦伏天真实的修为境界。
再看看如今神情淡然的秦伏天，南塔娜表情复杂，一时居然不知道该说什么。
一个练气三层的家伙，居然不担心被练气巅峰的鬼修追杀？而且丝毫不怕被抓到？
content_en:
Seize the body...replace the identity...
As soon as these two words came out, Qin Futian immediately remembered his previous life, when his close friend Tianluo God Emperor and his wife Feng Yaoguang were seized by the Demon Emperor of the Demon Clan, and they teamed up to kill him.
As a result, Qin Futian misunderstood Feng Yaoguang and his best friend for many years, and almost completely severed his relationship with Feng Yaoguang.
Qin Futian was a man who had not been afraid of many things in his two lives, but every time he thought about what happened back then, Qin Futian regretted it very much.
If he had been more cautious and prepared for the devil, his friend would not have died and his wife Feng Yaoguang would not have lost her memory.
This kind of regretful emotion will not make Qin Futian have inner demons, but it will make Qin Futian pay special attention when encountering relevant matters.
"Those who rely on snatching bodies to snatch someone else's identity... deserve to die!"
Qin Futian's eyes were slightly cold, but he shook his head.
"No, I can't take the others away."
With the blessing of the power of law, Qin Futian can allow himself to shuttle between metal and land at will, but it would be very expensive to bring others through, which he cannot afford yet.
If Qin Futian hadn't absorbed the energy that had been refined in the ghost cultivator tonight and broke through to the third level of Qi training, he wouldn't have been able to enter here.
Even if you have the power of law, if you don't have enough power to control it, you can only protect yourself.
When Feng Wutong heard this, he was a little disappointed, but he still waved his chubby hands freely.
"It's okay. As long as you can pass on the news, I will be grateful. If you have the opportunity to meet the Feng family in the future, remember to tell me that I, Feng Wutong, am not a coward. It is best to let them help me destroy Long Po Valley."
The woman who spoke to me before was a little disappointed, but she also said sincerely: "I hope fellow Taoists can go to Chiang Saen City and help me bring a message to the people in Najia.
My name is Nantana, and my sister's name is Parin. You only need to ask them to look in my mother's secret compartment, and they will naturally be able to prove your identity. "
Worried about Qin Futian's rejection, Nantana hurriedly said: "My Na family is a famous jade tycoon in Southeast Asia. It has many cultivation resources. I will be grateful afterwards."
Nantana, Palin, Najia...
Qin Futian silently recited these three names in his heart, feeling a little bit speechless.
He shook his head again and said calmly: "Don't be so pessimistic. Tomorrow I will find a way to solve the trouble here and open the door from the outside. You will be able to leave by then."
This room is not completely closed. Opposite the wall where Qin Futian came in, there is a metal door that is thicker than the wall. There are magic patterns engraved on the inside of the door and a ghost formation on the outside to check the identity of the visitor. The defense effect is excellent.
Although he could open it, he couldn't do it without disturbing others.
"According to the rules of Long Po Valley, there is usually only one ghost cultivator stationed here to protect Long Po's safety. But less than a thousand meters away from here, there is a small village, which is full of ghost cultivators in the Qi training period, and there are even ghost cultivators at the peak of Qi training.
As long as I alert them, I'm not afraid, but you will definitely be chased madly. In your current state, I'm afraid you won't be able to get any favors. "
Qin Futian, who had just broken through to the third level of Qi training, said calmly.
When he helped Feng Wutong break the rune chain before, he didn't hide his cultivation level.
Others had low cultivation levels and were in a daze and could not recognize him, but Feng Wutong and Nantana could easily feel Qin Futian's true cultivation level.
Looking at Qin Futian, who is now looking calm, Nantana has a complicated expression, and she doesn't know what to say for a moment.
A guy who is at the third level of Qi training is not worried about being chased by a ghost cultivator at the peak of Qi training? And not afraid of being caught at all?
